docs.description: Use for Nebula product behavior and AGENTS.md conventions

corona.description: Use for Corona design system (submodule) implementation details

nebula-safety.description: Reviews Nebula safety layers (deterministic classifier, sandbox, SSRF) for bypasses. Use when touching Safety, ShellExecutor, CommandSandbox, or FileWrite.

nebula-arch.description: Reviews Nebula architecture (Agent loop, 3 roots, Postgres, orchestration) before large changes.

audit-nebula.description: Run Nebula safety and architecture audit (mirrors /tmp manual tests)
audit-nebula.template: Faça uma auditoria do Nebula verificando Safety, Persistência, LLM e Docker. Use toolbox dotnet-dev se disponível. $ARGUMENTS

test-nebula.description: Run Nebula tests via toolbox (bypasses overlay restrictions)
test-nebula.template: toolbox run -c dotnet-dev -- bash -c 'dotnet test Nebula.Agent.Test --no-build -v minimal && dotnet test Nebula.App.Test --no-build -v minimal' $ARGUMENTS
